inventory01

Overstuffed family fridge

Crowded shelves, overlapping packages, stacked leftovers, turned labels, and produce behind cloudy drawers.

Expected behavior
{
  "observed_candidates": [
    {
      "label": "pitcher of brown liquid",
      "contents": null,
      "exact_remaining_volume": null
    },
    {
      "label": "dairy-style jug",
      "possible_identity": "milk",
      "identity_confirmed": false,
      "remaining_volume": null
    },
    {
      "label": "leafy greens in packaging",
      "species": null,
      "mass": null
    },
    {
      "label": "strawberries in a clamshell",
      "exact_count": null,
      "mass": null
    },
    {
      "label": "bag of shredded pale/orange food",
      "possible_identity": "shredded cheese",
      "identity_confirmed": false
    },
    {
      "label": "closed egg carton partly covered by other containers",
      "egg_count": null
    },
    {
      "label": "multiple lidded and wrapped food containers",
      "exact_contents": null
    },
    {
      "label": "flat package with pink slices",
      "possible_identity": "deli meat",
      "identity_confirmed": false
    },
    {
      "label": "produce behind drawer fronts",
      "possible_identities": [
        "carrots",
        "bell peppers",
        "leafy head vegetable"
      ],
      "exact_counts": null
    }
  ],
  "inventory_coverage": "partial despite a broad view",
  "completeness_claim_allowed": false,
  "expiry_dates": null,
  "exact_household_counts": null,
  "suggested_followup": "Ask for a closer photo of a specific obscured shelf or label when it would resolve a needed item or quantity."
}
Should avoid
  • Treat the broad view as a complete inventory or remove items that cannot be seen.
  • Count each visible fragment as a separate package when the fragments may belong to one obscured container.
  • Infer exact ingredient amounts, remaining milk volume, or the number of eggs inside the carton.
  • Treat generic packaging, nutrition panels, or container shape as proof of a specific product.
  • Invent dates, freshness, spoilage, or safety conclusions from an untidy fridge.
  • Treat possible receipt matches as new purchases or silently replace recorded quantities.

inventory02

Half-open door, obstructed view

Foreground bottles block the view; glare, soft focus, crinkled bags, and crowded shelves hide food and labels.

Expected behavior
{
  "observed_candidates": [
    {
      "label": "foreground condiment-style bottles",
      "exact_products": null,
      "remaining_amounts": null
    },
    {
      "label": "partly visible dairy-style jug",
      "possible_identity": "milk",
      "identity_confirmed": false,
      "remaining_volume": null
    },
    {
      "label": "closed egg carton",
      "egg_count": null
    },
    {
      "label": "leafy produce in overlapping clear bags",
      "species": null,
      "mass": null,
      "exact_package_count": null
    },
    {
      "label": "lidded food containers",
      "exact_contents": null
    },
    {
      "label": "tall carton with its front hidden",
      "contents": null
    },
    {
      "label": "wrapped cut green vegetable",
      "possible_identities": [
        "cucumber",
        "zucchini"
      ],
      "identity_confirmed": false
    },
    {
      "label": "orange root-like vegetables through plastic",
      "possible_identity": "carrots",
      "exact_count": null
    },
    {
      "label": "partly visible red vegetable",
      "possible_identity": "bell pepper",
      "exact_count": null
    }
  ],
  "inventory_coverage": "severely partial",
  "completeness_claim_allowed": false,
  "expiry_dates": null,
  "exact_household_counts": null,
  "suggested_followup": "Ask to open the door fully and photograph the blocked shelf or an unreadable label when needed."
}
Should avoid
  • Delete stored food based on failure to see it behind the door or other packages.
  • Assert exact brand, contents, amount, or expiration from an unreadable or turned-away label.
  • Report exact egg, produce, or package counts when items overlap or are inside closed containers.
  • Count separate visible patches of one bag as multiple purchases.
  • Require identification of fully hidden groceries to pass this fixture.
  • Infer freshness, spoilage, food safety, or household completeness from this single view.

receipt03

Warehouse receipt

Six grocery purchases with abbreviations, package sizes, and a yogurt multipack.

Expected behavior
{
  "food_purchase_lines": 6,
  "subtotal": 46.94,
  "tax": 0,
  "total": 46.94,
  "currency": "USD",
  "transaction_id": "PC-004218",
  "yogurt": {
    "purchased_multipacks": 1,
    "containers_per_multipack": 2,
    "ounces_per_container": 32
  }
}
Should avoid
  • Treat 24 eggs as 24 packages.
  • Treat 2x32 oz as two purchased multipacks.
  • Infer expiry dates, storage locations, or current remaining quantities from the purchase record.

Weighted produce, coupon, and return

Weighted bananas, multi-quantity food, a coupon, paper towels, and a milk return.

Expected behavior
{

  "non_food_purchase_lines": 1,
  "discount_lines": 1,
  "return_lines": 1,

Complete recipe screenshot

Expected behavior

meal08

Cooking photo with uncertain protein

Fusilli, red tomato pieces, wilted greens, and browned pale chunks in a skillet.

Expected behavior
{
  "observed_candidates": [
    "short spiral pasta",
    "small red tomato pieces",
    "wilted leafy greens",
    "browned pale chunks"
  ],
  "protein_identity": null,
  "exact_ingredient_quantities": null,
  "serving_count": null,
  "automatic_inventory_deductions": 0
}
Should avoid
  • Assert chicken versus a plant-based protein with certainty.
  • Deduct recipe quantities based only on visual similarity.
  • Infer allergens, exact oil/butter use, or food safety from the photo.
  • Assume this meal followed recipe-complete.

Photos were created with built-in image generation. Receipt and recipe screenshots were rendered from original HTML so text and arithmetic are reproducible. This is a development set, not a benchmark of real-world performance. Keep annotations and generation prompts separate from the inputs supplied to the agent being evaluated.
